meta.name: agentic-workshop-infrastructure
meta.description: Claude Code sandbox for this repository. Read-write: the repo, and its .git above workbench/, so the agent can commit (move $WORKDIR/../.git to filesystem.read and only a human commits). Read-only: the repo root above workbench/, because git starts there; without it every git command fails with "unable to get current working directory". The sandbox logs in on its own: the login lives in .claude-home/ (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, set by just claude). Not granted: your host login in ~/.claude and the macOS Keychain (nono's claude_code_macos group would grant the Keychain, so neither claude_code_* group is included), the push key and admin kubeconfig in ~/.local/state/agentic-workshop-infrastructure, so the agent can commit but cannot push, and sees the cluster only through the read-only .kubeconfig. Denied: ~/.ssh, ~/.kube, ~/.docker and the other credential stores. Git config: yours stays outside; just passes only your name and email (GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=.cache/sandbox.gitconfig). No shared caches in $HOME: tools keep theirs in .cache/ (set in flake.nix). Unix sockets: only under $TMPDIR (temp dir of nix develop). Linux needs af_unix_mediation for that, else nono passes every socket through: the agent reached ssh-agent and the D-Bus user bus, where `systemd-run --user` escapes the sandbox. macOS needs the deny on the ssh-agent socket; Docker's sits in the denied ~/.docker. Network unfiltered; nono-strict.json filters it and keeps the real login token out.
